Requirement Description: OCAH shall retain a functional control core during a systematic or random fault
OCAH shall have the capability to hold the chiplet in reset to maintain a safe state after a fault event
OCAH shall provide a mechanism for configuring and managing safety relevant configuration
When a systematic or random fault event happens, OCAH shall provide a mechanism for signalling critical errors and status outside of its boundaries
Comments: Error signals will be routed to SMO which is nominally utside of OCAH

Requirement Description: When a systematic or random fault event happens, OCAH shall provide a reliable mechanism for storing critical errors, error statistics, and error status.
OCAH SMC shall always provide a stable clock and reset for its resources
OCAH SMC shall always allow a stable sensing from external sensors (PVT and telemetry)
When a temperature sensor reports a value exceeding the critical temperature limit, OCAH SMC shall autonomously engage thermal capping to reduce thermal output
Comments: Note: bad dynamic power and thermal management (DPTM) in the long term leads to: component’s lifetime shortening, electromigration, dielectric breakdown due to thermal hot spots and sharp thermal gradients, and degraded operating speed due to leakage current exponentially increasing with temperature.

Requirement Description: When a voltage sensor reports a value exceeding the application power budget, OCAH SMC shall autonomously engage power capping to reduce the total power envelope
OCAH SMC shall prevent operation outside of pre-defined thermal and electrical power boundaries
OCAH SMC shall verify integrity of payload transferred between chiplets
OCAH SMC shall provide memory error detection and correction mechanisms against random faults to ensure data integrity
OCAH SMC shall provide fabric error detection mechanisms against random faults to ensure data integrity
OCAH SMC shall block unexpected transactions through its fabric
OCAH SMC shall have the capability to block fabric transactions violating the fabric access policy
OCAH SMC shall detect hangs of OCAH SMC CPU
OCAH SMC shall detect hangs of OCAH SMC fabric and devices connected to the fabric
When PLL and/or VRM actuation is issued from firmware, OCAH SMC shall always guarantee the actuation commands complete as expected
OCAH SMC shall be capable of detecting, reporting, and correcting errors happening during actuation control of PLL and/or VRMs from firmware
OCAH SMC shall ensure all HW sequencers transition within allowed states
OCAH SMC shall ensure transitions to illegal states in HW sequencers are detected and error signals propagated outside of OCAH
OCAH SMC shall detect unexpected interrupt trigger, priority assignment, and routing
OCAH SEP shall provide memory error detection and correction mechanisms against random faults to ensure data integrity
OCAH SEP shall verify the integrity and authenticity of firmware images before allowing execution
OCAH SEP shall prevent execution of firmware versions older than the minimum version recorded in the anti-rollback counter
OCAH SEP shall physically isolate secret key material from the software-accessible data bus to prevent unauthorized key exfiltration
OCAH SEP shall provide an emergency wipe mechanism capable of clearing all secret state (keys, vaults, scrambler state) upon detection of a security-critical fault
OCAH SEP shall ensure that the entropy source and DRBG meet NIST statistical quality requirements and detect degradation via online health monitoring
OCAH SEP shall ensure life cycle state transitions occur only through authenticated token matching with triple-redundant comparison logic
OCAH SEP shall detect inconsistencies in differentially encoded life cycle state and feature control signals
OCAH SEP shall block unexpected or unauthorized inbound and outbound fabric transactions through programmable traffic filtering
OCAH SEP shall ensure all HW sequencers and FSMs transition within allowed states
OCAH SEP shall ensure transitions to illegal states in HW sequencers are detected and error signals propagated outside of OCAH
OCAH SEP shall detect hangs of the OCAH SEP CPU through the Watchdog Timer
OCAH SEP shall detect and report errors in cryptographic operations including bus faults, memory parity errors, and CPU trap events from the Key Manager
OCAH SEP shall prevent unauthorized debug, test, and scan dump access according to the current life cycle state and feature control vectors
OCAH SEP shall ensure that fuse sensing completes successfully before releasing downstream logic and CPU execution
OCAH SEP shall protect OTP shadow registers, token values, and cryptographic keys from exposure through scan chains in all life cycle states
OCAH SEP shall detect unexpected interrupt trigger, priority assignment, and routing
OCAH SEP shall detect hangs of OCAH SEP fabric and devices connected to the fabric
